description: This file contains server-side logic for the SignUpPage in an online examination system. It handles page loading, navigation to the login page, and user registration including image upload, password validation, and database insertion.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the SignUpPage ASP.NET Web Form, managing user registration logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently empty but can be used for initialization.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the LoginPage when the login button is clicked.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Handles user registration, including image upload, password confirmation, and inserting user info into the database.
